description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Ultron triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Basalt Monolith that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
During your next turn, activate the Basalt Monolith token by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Basalt Monolith token.
Repeat from step 5.
